definitions.explanation: The measure or intensity of something. Used to express how much of a quality, condition, or state is present.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To examine the extent of the damage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧。
examples.english: The degree of nervousness differs from person to person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧⟦{治療法|ちりょうほう}→治療法：27941_chiryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Treatment methods need to be adjusted according to the severity of the symptoms.

notes:
USAGE:
Similar to ⟦{程度|ていど}→程度：01468_teido⟧ (degree, extent), but {度合|どあ}い is slightly more colloquial and often emphasizes variability — how much something varies along a scale. Commonly appears in the pattern ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い (the degree/extent of ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い: extent of damage
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度合|どあ}い: degree of tension
- {度合|どあ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧: according to the degree
- {度合|どあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧: to a high degree
- {度合|どあ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧: the degree differs
